messages.subject: Help with Interface design issue
parts:
When I use the following line, the text is printed on one line and the variabel value is printed on the next. 
 
h6(style="text-align:justify","Total Cost of Nonconformance = $",textOutput("totCost1"))
 
I want them on the same line.  Any ideas?

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Help with Interface design issue
parts:
With the latest version of shiny, use textOutput("totCost1", inline = TRUE).
